```tsx
        const periodGroup = allData.periodGroups.find(pg => pg.id === goal.periodGroupId);
        const period = periodGroup?.periods.find(p => p.id === goal.periodId);
        
        let target = goal.targetValue || 0;
        const goalType = allData.goalTypes.find(gt => gt.id === goal.goalTypeId);

        if(goal.hasLevels && goal.levelTargets) {
            target = goal.levelTargets.Diamante || 0;
        } else if (goalType && isFreteType(goalType)) {
             const mercantilGoal = allData.goals.find(g => {
                const mercantilGoalType = allData.goalTypes.find(t => t.id === g.goalTypeId && t.name.toLowerCase().includes('mercantil'));
                return g.periodId === goal.periodId && mercantilGoalType && 
                       g.branchId === goal.branchId && 
                       g.roleId === goal.roleId && 
                       g.userId === goal.userId;
            });
            const mercantilRealizado = mercantilGoal?.realizado ?? 0;
            const freightTargetPercentage = goal.targetValue ?? 0;
            target = (mercantilRealizado * freightTargetPercentage) / 100;
        }


        const realizado = goal.realizado || 0;
        const achievement = target > 0 ? (realizado / target) * 100 : 0;
        
        return {
            responsibleName,
            responsibleType,
            periodName: period?.name || 'N/A',
            goalTypeName: goalType?.name || "N/A",
            target: target,
            realizado: realizado,
            achievement: achievement,
        };
    }).sort((a,b) => a.responsibleName.localeCompare(b.responsibleName) || a.periodName.localeCompare(b.periodName));
  }, [allData, selectedPeriodGroupIds, selectedBranchIds, selectedRoleIds, selectedUserIds, selectedGoalTypeIds]);

  const reportTotals = React.useMemo(() => {
    const totalTarget = filteredReportData.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.target, 0);
    const totalRealizado = filteredReportData.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.realizado, 0);
    const totalAchievement = totalTarget > 0 ? (totalRealizado / totalTarget) * 100 : 0;
    return { totalTarget, totalRealizado, totalAchievement };
  }, [filteredReportData]);

  const clearAllFilters = () => {
    setSelectedPeriodGroupIds([]);
    setSelectedBranchIds([]);
    setSelectedRoleIds([]);
    setSelectedUserIds([]);
    setSelectedGoalTypeIds([]);
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex justify-center items-center h-96">
        <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-primary" />
      </div>
    );
  }
  
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold font-headline tracking-tight">Relatório Geral</h1>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">Analise os resultados detalhados com filtros combinados.</p>
        </div>
        <Button variant="outline" size="icon" onClick={fetchData} disabled={loading}>
          <RefreshCw className={loading ? "animate-spin h-4 w-4" : "h-4 w-4"} />
        </Button>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Filtros</CardTitle>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 pt-4">
            <MultiSelectFilter
              placeholder="Grupo de Períodos"
              options={allData?.periodGroups.map(g => ({value: g.id, label: g.name})) || []}
              selectedValues={selectedPeriodGroupIds}
              onSelectionChange={handleFilterChange(setSelectedPeriodGroupIds)}
            />
            <MultiSelectFilter
              placeholder="Tipo de Meta"
              options={allData?.goalTypes.map(gt => ({value: gt.id, label: gt.name})) || []}
              selectedValues={selectedGoalTypeIds}
              onSelectionChange={handleFilterChange(setSelectedGoalTypeIds)}
            />
             <MultiSelectFilter
              placeholder="Filial"
              options={allData?.branches.map(b => ({value: b.id, label: b.name})) || []}
              selectedValues={selectedBranchIds}
              onSelectionChange={handleFilterChange(setSelectedBranchIds)}
            />
             <MultiSelectFilter
              placeholder="Função"
              options={allData?.roles.map(r => ({value: r.id, label: r.name})) || []}
              selectedValues={selectedRoleIds}
              onSelectionChange={handleFilterChange(setSelectedRoleIds)}
            />
             <MultiSelectFilter
              placeholder="Vendedor"
              options={allData?.users.filter(u => u.roleId).map(u => ({value: u.id, label: u.name})) || []}
              selectedValues={selectedUserIds}
              onSelectionChange={handleFilterChange(setSelectedUserIds)}
            />
            <Button variant="ghost" onClick={clearAllFilters} className="text-destructive hover:text-destructive">
                <X className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                Limpar Filtros
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
           {filteredReportData.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-64 text-center">
                <Frown className="h-12 w-12 text-muted-foreground" />
                <p className="mt-4 text-muted-foreground">Nenhum resultado encontrado para os filtros selecionados.</p>
            </div>
           ) : (
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>Responsável</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Tipo de Meta</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Período</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">Meta</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">Realizado</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">Atingimento</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {filteredReportData.map((item, index) => (
                <TableRow key={index}>
                  <TableCell className="font-medium">{item.responsibleName}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell>{item.goalTypeName}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell>{item.periodName}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right">{formatCurrency(item.target)}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right">{formatCurrency(item.realizado)}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right">{formatPercentage(item.achievement)}</TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))}
            </TableBody>
             <TableFooter>
              <TableRow className="font-bold bg-muted">
                <TableCell colSpan={3}>Total</TableCell>
                <TableCell className="text-right">{formatCurrency(reportTotals.totalTarget)}</TableCell>
                <TableCell className="text-right">{formatCurrency(reportTotals.totalRealizado)}</TableCell>
                <TableCell className="text-right">{formatPercentage(reportTotals.totalAchievement)}</TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            </TableFooter>
          </Table>
           )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

```


--- FILE: src\app\dashboard\reports\roles\page.tsx ---

```tsx

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import {
  Loader2,
  BriefcaseBusiness,
  TrendingUp,
  Target,
  BarChart2,
  Calendar,
  Frown,
  TrendingDown,
  RefreshCw,
  Medal,
  Trophy,
  Award,
  Gem,
} from "lucide-react";
import {
  collection,
  getDocs,
  query,
  orderBy as firestoreOrderBy,
} from "firebase/firestore";
import { db } from "@/lib/firebase";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/tooltip";
import type {
  Goal,
  GoalType,
  PeriodGroup,
  Role,
  Period,
  GoalLevelTargets,
} from "@/lib/definitions";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/progress";
import { getGroupStatus } from "@/lib/period-helpers";
import { differenceInBusinessDays, isAfter, isBefore, parseISO } from "date-fns";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Accordion,
  AccordionContent,
  AccordionItem,
  AccordionTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/accordion";

type GoalTypeTotals = {
    goalType: GoalType;
    totalRealizado: number;
    totalMeta: number;
    totalAchievement: number;
    totalProjection: number;
}

type RoleReportData = {
  role: Role;
  goals: ProcessedGoal[];
  goalTypeTotals: GoalTypeTotals[];
};

type ProcessedGoal = {
  goal: Goal;
  goalType: GoalType;
  period: Period;
  metrics: GoalMetrics;
};

type GoalMetrics = {
  daysTotal: number;
  daysPassed: number;
  dailyGoal: number;
  projection: number;
  achievement: number;
  levelAchievements: { [key in keyof GoalLevelTargets]?: number };
  nextLevel: { name: keyof GoalLevelTargets; value: number } | null;
  remainingForNextLevel: number;
  remainingForTotal: number;
  totalLevelTarget: number;
};

const orderedLevels: Array<keyof GoalLevelTargets> = ['Bronze', 'Prata', 'Ouro', 'Diamante'];

const levelIcons: Record<keyof GoalLevelTargets, React.ReactNode> = {
    Bronze: <Medal className="h-4 w-4 text-orange-600" />,
    Prata: <Trophy className="h-4 w-4 text-slate-500" />,
    Ouro: <Award className="h-4 w-4 text-yellow-500" />,
    Diamante: <Gem className="h-4 w-4 text-sky-400" />,
};


export default function RolesReportPage() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [reportData, setReportData] = React.useState<RoleReportData[]>([]);
  const [periodGroups, setPeriodGroups] = React.useState<PeriodGroup[]>([]);
  const [selectedPeriodGroupId, setSelectedPeriodGroupId] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  const [allData, setAllData] = React.useState<{
      goals: Goal[],
      goalTypes: GoalType[],
      roles: Role[],
  } | null>(null);

  const formatCurrency = (value: number | undefined) => {
    if (value === undefined || isNaN(value)) return "R$ 0,00";
    return new Intl.NumberFormat("pt-BR", {
      style: "currency",
      currency: "BRL",
    }).format(value);
  };
  
  const formatPercentage = (value: number | undefined) => {
      if(value === undefined || isNaN(value)) return "0,00%";
      return `${value.toLocaleString('pt-BR', {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2})}%`;
  }

  const processData = React.useCallback(() => {
    if (!allData || !selectedPeriodGroupId) {
        setReportData([]);
        return;
    };
    
    const { goals, goalTypes, roles } = allData;

    const selectedGroup = periodGroups.find(p => p.id === selectedPeriodGroupId);
    
    if (!selectedGroup) {
        setReportData([]);
        return;
    }
    const targetPeriods = selectedGroup.periods;
    const targetPeriodIds = new Set(targetPeriods.map(p => p.id));

    const isFreteType = (gt: GoalType) => gt.name.toLowerCase().includes('frete');
    const isMercantilType = (gt: GoalType) => gt.name.toLowerCase().includes('mercantil');

    const roleReports = roles.map(role => {
      const roleGoals = goals.filter(g => 
        g.roleId === role.id &&
        !g.userId && // Ensure it's a role goal, not a user's goal who has this role
        targetPeriodIds.has(g.periodId)
      );
      
      const goalTypeTotalsMap: Map<string, { goalType: GoalType; totalRealizado: number; totalMeta: number; totalProjection: number; }> = new Map();

      const processedGoals: ProcessedGoal[] = roleGoals.map(goal => {
        const goalType = goalTypes.find(gt => gt.id === goal.goalTypeId)!;
        const period = targetPeriods.find(p => p.id === goal.periodId)!;
        const realizado = goal.realizado ?? 0;
        
        const today = new Date();
        today.setHours(0,0,0,0);
        const startDate = parseISO(period.startDate);
        const endDate = parseISO(period.endDate);
        
        const daysTotal = differenceInBusinessDays(endDate, startDate) + 1;
        let daysPassed = differenceInBusinessDays(today, startDate) + 1;
        if (isBefore(today, startDate)) daysPassed = 0;
        if (isAfter(today, endDate)) daysPassed = daysTotal;

        let targetValue = goal.targetValue ?? 0;
        let totalLevelTarget = 0;
        let achievement = 0;
        const originalGoal = {...goal};
        
        if (isFreteType(goalType)) {
          const mercantilGoal = roleGoals.find(g => {
            const gt = goalTypes.find(t => t.id === g.goalTypeId);
            return g.periodId === goal.periodId && gt && isMercantilType(gt);
          });
          const mercantilRealizado = mercantilGoal?.realizado ?? 0;
          const freightTargetPercentage = goal.targetValue ?? 0;
          const calculatedTarget = (mercantilRealizado * freightTargetPercentage) / 100;
          targetValue = calculatedTarget;
          originalGoal.targetValue = calculatedTarget;
        } else if (isMercantilType(goalType) && goal.hasLevels && goal.levelTargets) {
            totalLevelTarget = goal.levelTargets.Diamante || Object.values(goal.levelTargets).reduce((sum, value) => sum + (value || 0), 0);
            targetValue = totalLevelTarget;
            originalGoal.targetValue = targetValue;
        }

        if (targetValue > 0) {
            achievement = (realizado / targetValue) * 100;
        } else {
            achievement = realizado > 0 ? 100 : 0;
        }

        const dailyGoal = targetValue > 0 && daysTotal > 0 ? targetValue / daysTotal : 0;
        const projection = daysPassed > 0 ? (realizado / daysPassed) * daysTotal : 0;
        const remainingForTotal = Math.max(0, targetValue - realizado);
        
        if (!goalTypeTotalsMap.has(goal.goalTypeId)) {
          goalTypeTotalsMap.set(goal.goalTypeId, {
            goalType,
            totalRealizado: 0,
            totalMeta: 0,
            totalProjection: 0,
          });
        }
        
        const totals = goalTypeTotalsMap.get(goal.goalTypeId)!;
        totals.totalRealizado += realizado;
        totals.totalProjection += projection;
        totals.totalMeta += targetValue;
        
        const levelAchievements: { [key in keyof GoalLevelTargets]?: number } = {};
        if (goal.hasLevels && goal.levelTargets) {
            for (const level of orderedLevels) {
                const levelTarget = goal.levelTargets[level];
                if (levelTarget && levelTarget > 0) {
                    levelAchievements[level] = (realizado / levelTarget) * 100;
                }
            }
        }

        let nextLevel: { name: keyof GoalLevelTargets; value: number } | null = null;
        let remainingForNextLevel = 0;
        if (goal.hasLevels && goal.levelTargets) {
            for (const level of orderedLevels) {
                const levelTarget = goal.levelTargets[level];
                if (levelTarget && realizado < levelTarget) {
                    nextLevel = { name: level, value: levelTarget };
                    remainingForNextLevel = levelTarget - realizado;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        return {
          goal: originalGoal,
          goalType,
          period,
          metrics: {
            daysTotal,
            daysPassed,
            dailyGoal,
            projection,
            achievement,
            levelAchievements,
            nextLevel,
            remainingForNextLevel,
            remainingForTotal,
            totalLevelTarget
          }
        };
      }).sort((a,b) => {
        const periodComparison = a.period.name.localeCompare(b.period.name, undefined, { numeric: true });
        if (periodComparison !== 0) return periodComparison;
        return (a.goalType.order ?? 99) - (b.goalType.order ?? 99);
      });
      
      const goalTypeTotalsArray: GoalTypeTotals[] = Array.from(goalTypeTotalsMap.values()).map(total => ({
        ...total,
        totalAchievement: total.totalMeta > 0 ? (total.totalRealizado / total.totalMeta) * 100 : (total.totalRealizado > 0 ? 100 : 0)
      })).sort((a, b) => (a.goalType.order ?? 99) - (b.goalType.order ?? 99));

      return {
        role,
        goals: processedGoals,
        goalTypeTotals: goalTypeTotalsArray
      };
    });

    setReportData(roleReports.filter(r => r.goals.length > 0));

  }, [allData, selectedPeriodGroupId, periodGroups]);

  const fetchData = React.useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const [
        goalsSnap,
        typesSnap,
        periodsSnap,
        rolesSnap,
      ] = await Promise.all([
        getDocs(collection(db, "goals")),
        getDocs(query(collection(db, "goaltypes"), firestoreOrderBy("order"))),
        getDocs(collection(db, "periodgroups")),
        getDocs(collection(db, "roles")),
      ]);

      const goals = goalsSnap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }) as Goal);
      const goalTypes = typesSnap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }) as GoalType);
      const fetchedPeriodGroups = periodsSnap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }) as PeriodGroup);
      const roles = rolesSnap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }) as Role);
      
      setAllData({ goals, goalTypes, roles });
      
      const statusOrder = { "Ativo": 1, "Agendado": 2, "Encerrado": 3, "Vazio": 4 };
      fetchedPeriodGroups.sort((a, b) => {
        const statusA = getGroupStatus(a).text;
        const statusB = getGroupStatus(b).text;
        const orderA = statusOrder[statusA as keyof typeof statusOrder] || 99;
        const orderB = statusOrder[statusB as keyof typeof statusOrder] || 99;
        if (orderA !== orderB) {
            return orderA - orderB;
        }
        return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
      });
      setPeriodGroups(fetchedPeriodGroups);

      if (!selectedPeriodGroupId) {
          const firstActiveGroup = fetchedPeriodGroups.find(g => getGroupStatus(g).text === "Ativo");
          if (firstActiveGroup) {
            setSelectedPeriodGroupId(firstActiveGroup.id);
          } else if (fetchedPeriodGroups.length > 0) {
            setSelectedPeriodGroupId(fetchedPeriodGroups[0].id);
          }
      }

    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      toast({
        title: "Erro ao buscar dados",
        description: "Não foi possível carregar os dados para o relatório.",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [toast, selectedPeriodGroupId]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    fetchData();
  }, [fetchData]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!loading) {
      processData();
    }
  }, [selectedPeriodGroupId, loading, processData]);

  const renderMetric = (label: string, value: string | React.ReactNode, icon: React.ReactNode, tooltip?: string) => (
    <div className="flex flex-col space-y-1">
      <TooltipProvider>
        <Tooltip>
          <TooltipTrigger asChild>
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-help">
              {icon}
              {label}
            </span>
          </TooltipTrigger>
          {tooltip && <TooltipContent><p>{tooltip}</p></TooltipContent>}
        </Tooltip>
      </TooltipProvider>
      <span className="text-lg font-semibold">{value}</span>
    </div>
  );
  
  const selectedGroupName = periodGroups.find(g => g.id === selectedPeriodGroupId)?.name || 'Nenhum';

  const renderContent = () => {
    if (loading) {
      return (
        <div className="flex justify-center items-center h-96">
          <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-primary" />
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (reportData.length === 0) {
      return (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-96 rounded-lg border border-dashed">
          <Frown className="h-16 w-16 text-muted-foreground" />
          <h2 className="mt-4 text-xl font-semibold">Nenhum dado encontrado</h2>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Não há metas para funções no grupo '{selectedGroupName}'.</p>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return (
      <Accordion type="multiple" className="space-y-4" defaultValue={reportData.map(r => r.role.id)}>
        {reportData.map(({ role, goals, goalTypeTotals }) => {
          const goalsByPeriod = goals.reduce((acc, goal) => {
            const periodName = goal.period.name;
            if (!acc[periodName]) {
              acc[periodName] = [];
            }
            acc[periodName].push(goal);
            return acc;
          }, {} as Record<string, ProcessedGoal[]>);

          return (
            <AccordionItem value={role.id} key={role.id} className="border-b-0">
              <Card>
                <AccordionTrigger className="p-6 hover:no-underline">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                    <div className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-muted">
                      <BriefcaseBusiness className="h-6 w-6 text-muted-foreground" />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <CardTitle className="text-left">{role.name}</CardTitle>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </AccordionTrigger>
                <AccordionContent className="px-6 pb-6 space-y-4">
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold pt-4">Detalhes por Período</h3>
                  <Accordion type="multiple" className="space-y-4" defaultValue={Object.keys(goalsByPeriod)}>
                    {Object.entries(goalsByPeriod).map(([periodName, periodGoals]) => (
                      <AccordionItem value={periodName} key={periodName} className="border-b-0">
                        <AccordionTrigger className="py-3 px-4 bg-muted/50 rounded-md hover:no-underline">
                          <h3 className="font-semibold text-base">{periodName}</h3>
                        </AccordionTrigger>
                        <AccordionContent className="pt-4 space-y-4">
                          {periodGoals.map(({ goal, goalType, period, metrics }) => {
                            const isFreight = goalType.name.toLowerCase().includes('frete');
                            const isMercantil = goalType.name.toLowerCase().includes('mercantil');
                            const isCurrency = goalType.valueType === 'currency';
                            const formatFunction = isCurrency ? formatCurrency : formatPercentage;

                            return (
                              <div key={goal.id} className="space-y-4 rounded-lg border p-4">
                                <div className="relative flex justify-between items-center text-center mb-2 gap-2">
                                  <h4 className="font-bold text-lg text-primary">{goalType.name}</h4>
                                  <Badge variant={metrics.achievement >= 100 ? "default" : "secondary"}>
                                    {formatPercentage(metrics.achievement)}
                                  </Badge>
                                </div>
                                
                                {goal.hasLevels && goal.levelTargets ? (
                                  <div className="space-y-3">
                                    {orderedLevels.map(level => {
                                      const levelTarget = goal.levelTargets?.[level];
                                      if (!levelTarget || levelTarget <= 0) return null;
                                      const levelAchievement = metrics.levelAchievements[level] ?? 0;
                                      return (
                                        <div key={level} className="space-y-1">
                                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium">
                                              {levelIcons[level]}
                                              <span>{level}</span>
                                            </div>
                                            <div className="text-muted-foreground font-mono whitespace-nowrap ml-auto">
                                              <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{formatFunction(goal.realizado ?? 0)}</span> / {formatFunction(levelTarget)}
                                            </div>
                                          </div>
                                          <Progress value={levelAchievement} />
                                        </div>
                                      )
                                    })}
                                  </div>
                                ) : (
                                  <div>
                                    <div className="mb-1 flex justify-end text-sm font-medium">
                                      <div className="text-muted-foreground font-mono whitespace-nowrap">
                                        <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{isFreight ? formatCurrency(goal.realizado ?? 0) : formatCurrency(goal.realizado ?? 0)}</span> / {isFreight ? formatCurrency(goal.targetValue) : formatCurrency(goal.targetValue)}
                                      </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <Progress value={metrics.achievement} />
                                  </div>
                                )}

                                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-x-4 gap-y-6 pt-2">
                                  {renderMetric(
                                      "Meta Diária", 
                                      isFreight ? formatCurrency(metrics.dailyGoal) : formatFunction(metrics.dailyGoal), 
                                      <Target className="h-4 w-4" />,
                                      "Valor que precisa ser vendido por dia útil para atingir a meta."
                                  )}
                                  {renderMetric(
                                      "Projeção", 
                                      isFreight ? formatCurrency(metrics.projection) : formatFunction(metrics.projection), 
                                      metrics.projection >= (goal.targetValue ?? 0) ? <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500"/> : <TrendingDown className="h-4 w-4 text-red-500" />,
                                      "Estimativa de resultado no final do período com base no desempenho atual."
                                  )}
                                  {renderMetric(
                                      "Dias", 
                                      `${metrics.daysPassed}/${metrics.daysTotal}`, 
                                      <Calendar className="h-4 w-4" />,
                                      "Dias úteis decorridos / Total de dias úteis no período."
                                  )}
                                  {isMercantil && metrics.totalLevelTarget > 0 ? (
                                    <>
                                      {renderMetric(
                                          "Meta Diamante",
                                          formatCurrency(metrics.totalLevelTarget),
                                          <Gem className="h-4 w-4 text-sky-400" />,
                                          "Valor da meta Diamante."
                                      )}
                                      {metrics.nextLevel ? (
                                        renderMetric(
                                          `Próx. Nível (${metrics.nextLevel.name})`,
                                          formatCurrency(metrics.remainingForNextLevel),
                                          levelIcons[metrics.nextLevel.name],
                                          `Faltam ${formatCurrency(metrics.remainingForNextLevel)} para atingir o nível ${metrics.nextLevel.name} (${formatCurrency(metrics.nextLevel.value)})`
                                        )
                                      ) : (
                                        renderMetric(
                                          "Nível máximo atingido!",
                                          " ",
                                          <Gem className="h-4 w-4 text-sky-400" />,
                                          "Todos os níveis foram atingidos!"
                                        )
                                      )}
                                      {renderMetric(
                                          "Falta para Diamante",
                                          formatCurrency(Math.max(0, metrics.totalLevelTarget - (goal.realizado ?? 0))),
                                          <BarChart2 className="h-4 w-4" />,
                                          "Valor restante para atingir a meta Diamante."
                                      )}
                                    </>
                                  ) : goal.hasLevels ? (
                                      metrics.nextLevel ? (
                                          renderMetric(
                                          `Próx. Nível (${metrics.nextLevel.name})`,
                                          formatFunction(metrics.remainingForNextLevel),
                                          <BarChart2 className="h-4 w-4" />,
                                          `Faltam ${formatFunction(metrics.remainingForNextLevel)} para atingir o nível ${metrics.nextLevel.name} (${formatFunction(metrics.nextLevel.value)})`
                                          )
                                      ) : (
                                        renderMetric(
                                          "Nível máximo atingido!",
                                          " ",
                                          <Gem className="h-4 w-4 text-sky-400" />,
                                          "Todos os níveis foram atingidos!"
                                        )
                                      )
                                      ) : (
                                      renderMetric(
                                          "Falta para a Meta",
                                          isFreight ? formatCurrency(metrics.remainingForTotal) : formatFunction(metrics.remainingForTotal),
                                          <BarChart2 className="h-4 w-4" />,
                                          `Falta para atingir a meta total de ${isFreight ? formatCurrency(goal.targetValue) : formatFunction(goal.targetValue)}`
                                      )
                                    )}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            )
                          })}
                        </AccordionContent>
                      </AccordionItem>
                    ))}
                  </Accordion>
                  <div className="space-y-4 pt-4">
                    <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold">Resumo Total do Grupo</h3>
                    {goalTypeTotals.map(total => (
                      <Card key={total.goalType.id} className="bg-muted/30">
                        <CardHeader>
                          <CardTitle className="text-lg">Total da Meta: {total.goalType.name}</CardTitle>
                        </CardHeader>
                        <CardContent>
                          <div className="mb-2">
                            <div className="mb-1 flex justify-end text-sm font-medium">
                              <div className="text-muted-foreground font-mono whitespace-nowrap ml-auto">
                                <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{formatCurrency(total.totalRealizado)}</span> / {formatCurrency(total.totalMeta)}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                            <Progress value={total.totalAchievement} />
                          </div>
                          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 pt-2">
                            {renderMetric(
                                "Atingimento Total", 
                                formatPercentage(total.totalAchievement), 
                                <Award className="h-4 w-4" />
                            )}
                            {renderMetric(
                                "Projeção Total",
                                formatCurrency(total.totalProjection),
                                total.totalProjection >= total.totalMeta ? <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500"/> : <TrendingDown className="h-4 w-4 text-red-500" />,
                                "Estimativa de resultado total no final do grupo de períodos com base no desempenho atual."
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </CardContent>
                      </Card>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </AccordionContent>
              </Card>
            </AccordionItem>
          );
        })}
      </Accordion>
    )
  }
  
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold font-headline tracking-tight">
            Relatório de Funções
          </h1>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">
            Acompanhe o desempenho de cada função com base no grupo de períodos selecionado.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Select value={selectedPeriodGroupId || ''} onValueChange={(value) => setSelectedPeriodGroupId(value)}>
            <SelectTrigger className="w-[280px]">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Selecione um Grupo" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              {periodGroups.map(group => {
                const status = getGroupStatus(group);
                return (
                  <SelectItem key={group.id} value={group.id}>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span>{group.name}</span>
                      <Badge variant={status.variant} className="ml-4">{status.text}</Badge>
                    </div>
                  </SelectItem>
                )
              })}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
          <Button variant="outline" size="icon" onClick={() => fetchData()} disabled={loading}>
            <RefreshCw className={loading ? "animate-spin h-4 w-4" : "h-4 w-4"} />
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Desempenho por Função</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>Análise detalhada do desempenho de cada função.</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
            {renderContent()}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

```


--- FILE: src\app\dashboard\reports\sellers\page.tsx ---

```tsx

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import {
  Loader2,
  User as UserIcon,
  TrendingUp,
  Target,
  BarChart2,
  Calendar,
  Frown,
  TrendingDown,
  RefreshCw,
  Medal,
  Trophy,
  Award,
  Gem,
  Save,
  FileText,
  Check,
} from "lucide-react";
import {
  collection,
  getDocs,
  query,
  orderBy as firestoreOrderBy,
  doc,
  updateDoc,
  getDoc,
} from "firebase/firestore";
import { db, auth } from "@/lib/firebase";
import { useAuthState } from "react-firebase-hooks/auth";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/tooltip";
import type {
  Goal,
  GoalType,
  PeriodGroup,
  User,
  Role,
  Period,
  GoalLevelTargets,
} from "@/lib/definitions";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/progress";
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from "@/components/ui/avatar";
import { getGroupStatus } from "@/lib/period-helpers";
import { differenceInBusinessDays, isAfter, isBefore, parseISO } from "date-fns";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Accordion,
  AccordionContent,
  AccordionItem,
  AccordionTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/accordion";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { errorEmitter, FirestorePermissionError } from "@/lib/firebase-error-handler";

type GoalTypeTotals = {
    goalType: GoalType;
    totalRealizado: number;
    totalMeta: number;
    totalAchievement: number;
    totalProjection: number;
    totalLevelTargets: GoalLevelTargets;
    daysPassed: number;
    daysTotal: number;
    dailyGoal: number;
    nextLevel: { name: keyof GoalLevelTargets; value: number } | null;
    remainingForNextLevel: number;
}

type SellerReportData = {
  seller: User;
  goals: ProcessedGoal[];
  goalTypeTotals: GoalTypeTotals[];
};

type ProcessedGoal = {
  goal: Goal;
  goalType: GoalType;
  period: Period;
  metrics: GoalMetrics;
};

type GoalMetrics = {
  daysTotal: number;
  daysPassed: number;
  dailyGoal: number;
  projection: number;
  achievement: number;
  levelAchievements: { [key in keyof GoalLevelTargets]?: number };
  nextLevel: { name: keyof GoalLevelTargets; value: number } | null;
  remainingForNextLevel: number;
  remainingForTotal: number;
  totalLevelTarget: number;
};

const orderedLevels: Array<keyof GoalLevelTargets> = ['Bronze', 'Prata', 'Ouro', 'Diamante'];

const levelIcons: Record<keyof GoalLevelTargets, React.ReactNode> = {
    Bronze: <Medal className="h-4 w-4 text-orange-600" />,
    Prata: <Trophy className="h-4 w-4 text-slate-500" />,
    Ouro: <Award className="h-4 w-4 text-yellow-500" />,
    Diamante: <Gem className="h-4 w-4 text-sky-400" />,
};


export default function SellersReportPage() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [user, authLoading] = useAuthState(auth);
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [reportData, setReportData] = React.useState<SellerReportData[]>([]);
  const [periodGroups, setPeriodGroups] = React.useState<PeriodGroup[]>([]);
  const [selectedPeriodGroupId, setSelectedPeriodGroupId] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  
  const [isSavingNote, setIsSavingNote] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [justSavedNote, setJustSavedNote] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notes, setNotes] = React.useState<{[key: string]: string}>({});

  const [allData, setAllData] = React.useState<{
      goals: Goal[],
      goalTypes: GoalType[],
      users: User[],
      roles: Role[],
      currentUser: User | null,
  } | null>(null);

  const formatCurrency = (value: number | undefined) => {
    if (value === undefined || isNaN(value)) return "R$ 0,00";
    return new Intl.NumberFormat("pt-BR", {
      style: "currency",
      currency: "BRL",
    }).format(value);
  };
  
  const formatPercentage = (value: number | undefined) => {
      if(value === undefined || isNaN(value)) return "0,00%";
      return `${value.toLocaleString('pt-BR', {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2})}%`;
  }

  const processData = React.useCallback(() => {
    if (!allData || !selectedPeriodGroupId) {
        setReportData([]);
        return;
    };
    
    const { goals, goalTypes, users, roles, currentUser } = allData;

    let sellers = users.filter(u => u.roleId && u.roleId.trim() !== "");
    
    if (currentUser && !currentUser.isAdmin) {
        sellers = sellers.filter(seller => seller.branchId === currentUser.branchId);
    }
    
    const selectedGroup = periodGroups.find(p => p.id === selectedPeriodGroupId);
    
    if (!selectedGroup) {
        setReportData([]);
        return;
    }
    const targetPeriods = selectedGroup.periods;
    const targetPeriodIds = new Set(targetPeriods.map(p => p.id));

    const isFreteType = (gt: GoalType) => gt.name.toLowerCase().includes('frete');
    const isMercantilType = (gt: GoalType) => gt.name.toLowerCase().includes('mercantil');

    const sellerReports = sellers.map(seller => {
      const sellerGoals = goals.filter(g => 
        g.userId === seller.id && // Only goals directly assigned to the user
        targetPeriodIds.has(g.periodId)
      );
      
      const goalTypeTotalsMap: Map<string, Omit<GoalTypeTotals, 'totalAchievement' | 'nextLevel' | 'remainingForNextLevel' | 'dailyGoal'>> = new Map();

      const processedGoals: ProcessedGoal[] = sellerGoals.map(goal => {
        const goalType = goalTypes.find(gt => gt.id === goal.goalTypeId)!;
        const period = targetPeriods.find(p => p.id === goal.periodId)!;
        const realizado = goal.realizado ?? 0;
        
        const today = new Date();
        today.setHours(0,0,0,0);
        const startDate = parseISO(period.startDate);
        const endDate = parseISO(period.endDate);
        
        const daysTotal = differenceInBusinessDays(endDate, startDate) + 1;
        let daysPassed = differenceInBusinessDays(today, startDate) + 1;
        if (isBefore(today, startDate)) daysPassed = 0;
        if (isAfter(today, endDate)) daysPassed = daysTotal;

        let targetValue = goal.targetValue ?? 0;
        let totalLevelTarget = 0;
        let achievement = 0;
        const originalGoal = {...goal};
        
        if (isFreteType(goalType)) {
          const mercantilGoal = sellerGoals.find(g => {
            const gt = goalTypes.find(t => t.id === g.goalTypeId);
            return g.periodId === goal.periodId && gt && isMercantilType(gt);
          });
          const mercantilRealizado = mercantilGoal?.realizado ?? 0;
          const freightTargetPercentage = goal.targetValue ?? 0;
          const calculatedTarget = (mercantilRealizado * freightTargetPercentage) / 100;
          targetValue = calculatedTarget;
          originalGoal.targetValue = calculatedTarget;
        } else if (isMercantilType(goalType) && goal.hasLevels && goal.levelTargets) {
            totalLevelTarget = goal.levelTargets.Diamante || 0;
            targetValue = totalLevelTarget;
            originalGoal.targetValue = targetValue;
        }


        if (targetValue > 0) {
            achievement = (realizado / targetValue) * 100;
        } else {
            achievement = realizado > 0 ? 100 : 0;
        }

        const dailyGoal = targetValue > 0 && daysTotal > 0 ? targetValue / daysTotal : 0;
        const projection = daysPassed > 0 ? (realizado / daysPassed) * daysTotal : 0;
        const remainingForTotal = Math.max(0, targetValue - realizado);
        
        if (!goalTypeTotalsMap.has(goal.goalTypeId)) {
          goalTypeTotalsMap.set(goal.goalTypeId, {
            goalType,
            totalRealizado: 0,
            totalMeta: 0,
            totalLevelTargets: { Bronze: 0, Prata: 0, Ouro: 0, Diamante: 0 },
            totalProjection: 0,
            daysPassed: 0,
            daysTotal: 0,
          });
        }
        
        const totals = goalTypeTotalsMap.get(goal.goalTypeId)!;
        totals.totalRealizado += realizado;
        totals.totalProjection += projection;
        
        let currentMetaForTotal = targetValue;
        if (goal.hasLevels && goal.levelTargets && isMercantilType(goalType)) {
            currentMetaForTotal = goal.levelTargets.Diamante || 0;
        }
        totals.totalMeta += currentMetaForTotal;
        
        totals.daysPassed = Math.max(totals.daysPassed, daysPassed);
        totals.daysTotal = Math.max(totals.daysTotal, daysTotal);

        if (goal.hasLevels && goal.levelTargets) {
            totals.totalLevelTargets.Bronze += goal.levelTargets.Bronze || 0;
            totals.totalLevelTargets.Prata += goal.levelTargets.Prata || 0;
            totals.totalLevelTargets.Ouro += goal.levelTargets.Ouro || 0;
            totals.totalLevelTargets.Diamante += goal.levelTargets.Diamante || 0;
        }
        
        const levelAchievements: { [key in keyof GoalLevelTargets]?: number } = {};
        if (goal.hasLevels && goal.levelTargets) {
            for (const level of orderedLevels) {
                const levelTarget = goal.levelTargets[level];
                if (levelTarget && levelTarget > 0) {
                    levelAchievements[level] = (realizado / levelTarget) * 100;
                }
            }
        }

        let nextLevel: { name: keyof GoalLevelTargets; value: number } | null = null;
        let remainingForNextLevel = 0;
        if (goal.hasLevels && goal.levelTargets) {
            for (const level of orderedLevels) {
                const levelTarget = goal.levelTargets[level];
                if (levelTarget && realizado < levelTarget) {
                    nextLevel = { name: level, value: levelTarget };
                    remainingForNextLevel = levelTarget - realizado;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        return {
          goal: originalGoal,
          goalType,
          period,
          metrics: {
            daysTotal,
            daysPassed,
            dailyGoal,
            projection,
            achievement,
            levelAchievements,
            nextLevel,
            remainingForNextLevel,
            remainingForTotal,
            totalLevelTarget
          }
        };
      }).sort((a,b) => {
        const periodComparison = a.period.name.localeCompare(b.period.name, undefined, { numeric: true });
        if (periodComparison !== 0) return periodComparison;
        return (a.goalType.order ?? 99) - (b.goalType.order ?? 99);
      });
      
      const goalTypeTotalsArray: GoalTypeTotals[] = Array.from(goalTypeTotalsMap.values()).map(total => {
        let nextLevel: { name: keyof GoalLevelTargets; value: number } | null = null;
        let remainingForNextLevel = 0;

        if (Object.values(total.totalLevelTargets).some(v => v > 0)) {
           for (const level of orderedLevels) {
                const levelTarget = total.totalLevelTargets[level];
                if (levelTarget && total.totalRealizado < levelTarget) {
                    nextLevel = { name: level, value: levelTarget };
                    remainingForNextLevel = levelTarget - total.totalRealizado;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        return {
            ...total,
            totalAchievement: total.totalMeta > 0 ? (total.totalRealizado / total.totalMeta) * 100 : (total.totalRealizado > 0 ? 100 : 0),
            dailyGoal: total.totalMeta > 0 && total.daysTotal > 0 ? total.totalMeta / total.daysTotal : 0,
            nextLevel,
            remainingForNextLevel,
        }
      }).sort((a, b) => (a.goalType.order ?? 99) - (b.goalType.order ?? 99));

      return {
        seller,
        goals: processedGoals,
        goalTypeTotals: goalTypeTotalsArray
      };
    });

    setReportData(sellerReports.filter(r => r.goals.length > 0));

  }, [allData, selectedPeriodGroupId, periodGroups]);

  const fetchData = React.useCallback(async () => {
    if (!user) return;
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const [
        goalsSnap,
        typesSnap,
        periodsSnap,
        usersSnap,
        rolesSnap,
        currentUserSnap,
      ] = await Promise.all([
        getDocs(collection(db, "goals")),
        getDocs(query(collection(db, "goaltypes"), firestoreOrderBy("order"))),
        getDocs(collection(db, "periodgroups")),
        getDocs(collection(db, "users")),
        getDocs(collection(db, "roles")),
        getDoc(doc(db, "users", user.uid))
      ]);

      const goals = goalsSnap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }) as Goal);
      const goalTypes = typesSnap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }) as GoalType);
      const fetchedPeriodGroups = periodsSnap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }) as PeriodGroup);
      const users = usersSnap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }) as User);
      const roles = rolesSnap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }) as Role);
      const currentUser = currentUserSnap.exists() ? currentUserSnap.data() as User : null;
      
      setAllData({ goals, goalTypes, users, roles, currentUser });
      
      const statusOrder = { "Ativo": 1, "Agendado": 2, "Encerrado": 3, "Vazio": 4 };
      fetchedPeriodGroups.sort((a, b) => {
        const statusA = getGroupStatus(a).text;
        const statusB = getGroupStatus(b).text;
        const orderA = statusOrder[statusA as keyof typeof statusOrder] || 99;
        const orderB = statusOrder[statusB as keyof typeof statusOrder] || 99;
        if (orderA !== orderB) {
            return orderA - orderB;
        }
        return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
      });
      setPeriodGroups(fetchedPeriodGroups);

      if (users.length > 0) {
        const initialNotes: {[key: string]: string} = {};
        users.forEach(u => {
            if (u.notes && selectedPeriodGroupId && u.notes[selectedPeriodGroupId]) {
                initialNotes[u.id] = u.notes[selectedPeriodGroupId];
            }
        });
        setNotes(initialNotes);
      }

      if (!selectedPeriodGroupId) {
          const firstActiveGroup = fetchedPeriodGroups.find(g => getGroupStatus(g).text === "Ativo");
          if (firstActiveGroup) {
            setSelectedPeriodGroupId(firstActiveGroup.id);
          } else if (fetchedPeriodGroups.length > 0) {
            setSelectedPeriodGroupId(fetchedPeriodGroups[0].id);
          }
      }

    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      toast({
        title: "Erro ao buscar dados",
        description: "Não foi possível carregar os dados para o relatório.",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [toast, user, selectedPeriodGroupId]);
  
  const handleSaveNote = async (sellerId: string) => {
    if (!selectedPeriodGroupId) {
        toast({ title: "Selecione um Grupo de Períodos", variant: "destructive"});
        return;
    }
    setIsSavingNote(sellerId);
    try {
        const docRef = doc(db, "users", sellerId);
        
        const userDoc = await getDoc(docRef);
        const userData = userDoc.data() as User;
        const currentNotes = userData.notes || {};
        const newNotes = {
            ...currentNotes,
            [selectedPeriodGroupId]: notes[sellerId] || ""
        };

        await updateDoc(docRef, { notes: newNotes });
        setJustSavedNote(sellerId);
        setTimeout(() => setJustSavedNote(null), 2000);
    } catch (error: any) {
        if (error.code === 'permission-denied') {
            const dataToSave = { notes: { [selectedPeriodGroupId]: notes[sellerId] || "" } };
            errorEmitter.emit('permission-error', new FirestorePermissionError(error, {
                operation: 'write',
                path: `users/${sellerId}`,
                resource: dataToSave,
            }));
        } else {
            toast({ title: "Erro ao salvar anotação", variant: "destructive" });
        }
    } finally {
        setIsSavingNote(null);
    }
  };

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if(user) fetchData();
  }, [fetchData, user]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!loading) {
      processData();
    }
  }, [selectedPeriodGroupId, loading, processData]);

   React.useEffect(() => {
    if (allData?.users && selectedPeriodGroupId) {
      const newNotes: {[key: string]: string} = {};
      allData.users.forEach(u => {
        if (u.notes && u.notes[selectedPeriodGroupId]) {
          newNotes[u.id] = u.notes[selectedPeriodGroupId];
        }
      });
      setNotes(newNotes);
    }
  }, [selectedPeriodGroupId, allData]);


  const renderMetric = (label: string, value: string | React.ReactNode, icon: React.ReactNode, tooltip?: string) => (
    <div className="flex flex-col space-y-1">
      <TooltipProvider>
        <Tooltip>
          <TooltipTrigger asChild>
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-help">
              {icon}
              {label}
            </span>
          </TooltipTrigger>
          {tooltip && <TooltipContent><p>{tooltip}</p></TooltipContent>}
        </Tooltip>
      </TooltipProvider>
      <span className="text-lg font-semibold">{value}</span>
    </div>
  );
  
  const selectedGroupName = periodGroups.find(g => g.id === selectedPeriodGroupId)?.name || 'Nenhum';

  if (loading || authLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex justify-center items-center h-96">
        <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-primary" />
      </div>
    );
  }
  
  return (
    <>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold font-headline tracking-tight">
              Relatório de Vendedores
            </h1>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground">
              Acompanhe o desempenho da sua equipe com base no grupo de períodos selecionado.
            </p>
          </div>
           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Select value={selectedPeriodGroupId || ''} onValueChange={(value) => setSelectedPeriodGroupId(value)}>
              <SelectTrigger className="w-[280px]">
                <SelectValue placeholder="Selecione um Grupo" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {periodGroups.map(group => {
                  const status = getGroupStatus(group);
                  return (
                    <SelectItem key={group.id} value={group.id}>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span>{group.name}</span>
                        <Badge variant={status.variant} className="ml-4">{status.text}</Badge>
                      </div>
                    </SelectItem>
                  )
                })}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
            <Button variant="outline" size="icon" onClick={() => fetchData()} disabled={loading}>
              <RefreshCw className={loading ? "animate-spin h-4 w-4" : "h-4 w-4"} />
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {reportData.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-96 rounded-lg border border-dashed">
            <Frown className="h-16 w-16 text-muted-foreground" />
            <h2 className="mt-4 text-xl font-semibold">Nenhum dado encontrado</h2>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Não há metas para vendedores no grupo '{selectedGroupName}'.</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <Accordion type="multiple" className="space-y-4" defaultValue={reportData.map(r => r.seller.id)}>
            {reportData.map(({ seller, goals, goalTypeTotals }) => {
                const goalsByPeriod = goals.reduce((acc, goal) => {
                    const periodName = goal.period.name;
                    if (!acc[periodName]) {
                        acc[periodName] = [];
                    }
                    acc[periodName].push(goal);
                    return acc;
                }, {} as Record<string, ProcessedGoal[]>);

                return (
                    <AccordionItem value={seller.id} key={seller.id} className="border-b-0">
                        <Card>
                        <AccordionTrigger className="p-6 hover:no-underline">
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                                    <Avatar className="h-12 w-12">
                                    <AvatarImage src={seller.avatarUrl} alt={seller.name}/>
                                    <AvatarFallback>{seller.name.charAt(0)}</AvatarFallback>
                                    </Avatar>
                                    <div>
                                        <CardTitle className="text-left">{seller.name}</CardTitle>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                {notes[seller.id] && (
                                    <div onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} className="mr-4">
                                        <TooltipProvider>
                                            <Tooltip>
                                                <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                                                    <div className="p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-muted">
                                                        <FileText className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                                                    </div>
                                                </TooltipTrigger>
                                                <TooltipContent>
                                                    <p>Este vendedor possui anotações neste período.</p>
                                                </TooltipContent>
                                            </Tooltip>
                                        </TooltipProvider>
                                    </div>
                                )}
                            </div>
                        </AccordionTrigger>
                        <AccordionContent className="px-6 pb-6 space-y-4">
                            <Accordion type="multiple" className="space-y-4" defaultValue={Object.keys(goalsByPeriod)}>
                            {Object.entries(goalsByPeriod).map(([periodName, periodGoals]) => {

                                return (
                                    <AccordionItem value={periodName} key={periodName} className="border-b-0">
                                        <AccordionTrigger className="py-3 px-4 bg-muted/50 rounded-md hover:no-underline">
                                            <h3 className="font-semibold text-base">{periodName}</h3>
                                        </AccordionTrigger>
                                        <AccordionContent className="pt-4 space-y-4">
                                            <div className="pt-2">
                                                <Label htmlFor={`notes-${seller.id}`} className="font-semibold">Anotações sobre o Desempenho</Label>
                                                <Textarea 
                                                    id={`notes-${seller.id}`}
                                                    className="mt-2"
                                                    placeholder="Adicione anotações, feedbacks ou próximos passos..."
                                                    value={notes[seller.id] || ""}
                                                    onChange={(e) => setNotes(prev => ({...prev, [seller.id]: e.target.value}))}
                                                    rows={4}
                                                />
                                                <Button
                                                    size="sm"
                                                    className="mt-2"
                                                    onClick={() => handleSaveNote(seller.id)}
                                                    disabled={isSavingNote === seller.id}
                                                >
                                                    {isSavingNote === seller.id ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin"/> : (justSavedNote === seller.id ? <Check className="h-4 w-4"/> : <Save className="h-4 w-4" />)}
                                                    <span className="ml-2">{justSavedNote === seller.id ? "Salvo!" : "Salvar Anotações"}</span>
                                                </Button>
                                            </div>
                                            {periodGoals.map(({ goal, goalType, period, metrics }) => {
                                                const isFreight = goalType.name.toLowerCase().includes('frete');
                                                const isMercantil = goalType.name.toLowerCase().includes('mercantil');
                                                const isCurrency = goalType.valueType === 'currency';
                                                const formatFunction = isCurrency ? formatCurrency : formatPercentage;

                                                return (
                                                <div key={goal.id} className="space-y-4 rounded-lg border p-4">
                                                    <div className="relative flex justify-between items-center text-center mb-2 gap-2">
                                                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{goal.name}</p>
                                                        <h4 className="font-bold text-lg text-primary absolute left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2">{goalType.name}</h4>
                                                        <Badge variant={metrics.achievement >= 100 ? "default" : "secondary"}>
                                                            {formatPercentage(metrics.achievement)}
                                                        </Badge>
                                                    </div>
                                                    
                                                    {goal.hasLevels && goal.levelTargets ? (
                                                    <div className="space-y-3">
                                                        {orderedLevels.map(level => {
                                                            const levelTarget = goal.levelTargets?.[level];
                                                            if (!levelTarget || levelTarget <= 0) return null;
                                                            const levelAchievement = metrics.levelAchievements[level] ?? 0;
                                                            return (
                                                            <div key={level} className="space-y-1">
                                                                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                                                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium">
                                                                    {levelIcons[level]}
                                                                    <span>{level}</span>
                                                                    </div>
                                                                    <div className="text-muted-foreground font-mono whitespace-nowrap ml-auto">
                                                                        <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{formatFunction(goal.realizado ?? 0)}</span> / {formatFunction(levelTarget)}
                                                                    </div>
                                                                </div>
                                                                <Progress value={levelAchievement} />
                                                            </div>
                                                            )
                                                        })}
                                                    </div>
                                                    ) : (
                                                    <div>
                                                        <div className="mb-1 flex justify-end text-sm font-medium">
                                                          <div className="text-muted-foreground font-mono whitespace-nowrap">
                                                            <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{isFreight ? formatCurrency(goal.realizado ?? 0) : formatCurrency(goal.realizado ?? 0)}</span> / {isFreight ? formatCurrency(goal.targetValue) : formatCurrency(goal.targetValue)}
                                                          </div>
                                                        </div>
                                                        <Progress value={metrics.achievement} />
                                                    </div>
                                                    )}

                                                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-x-4 gap-y-6 pt-2">
                                                    {renderMetric(
                                                        "Meta Diária", 
                                                        isFreight ? formatCurrency(metrics.dailyGoal) : formatFunction(metrics.dailyGoal), 
                                                        <Target className="h-4 w-4" />,
                                                        "Valor que precisa ser vendido por dia útil para atingir a meta."
                                                    )}
                                                    {renderMetric(
                                                        "Projeção", 
                                                        isFreight ? formatCurrency(metrics.projection) : formatFunction(metrics.projection), 
                                                        metrics.projection >= (goal.targetValue ?? 0) ? <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500"/> : <TrendingDown className="h-4 w-4 text-red-500" />,
                                                        "Estimativa de resultado no final do período com base no desempenho atual."
                                                    )}
                                                    {renderMetric(
                                                        "Dias", 
                                                        `${metrics.daysPassed}/${metrics.daysTotal}`, 
                                                        <Calendar className="h-4 w-4" />,
                                                        "Dias úteis decorridos / Total de dias úteis no período."
                                                    )}
                                                    {isMercantil && metrics.totalLevelTarget > 0 ? (
                                                        <>
                                                        {renderMetric(
                                                            "Meta Diamante",
                                                            formatCurrency(metrics.totalLevelTarget),
                                                            <Gem className="h-4 w-4 text-sky-400" />,
                                                            "Valor da meta Diamante."
                                                        )}
                                                            {metrics.nextLevel ? (
                                                            renderMetric(
                                                            `Próx. Nível (${metrics.nextLevel.name})`,
                                                            formatCurrency(metrics.remainingForNextLevel),
                                                            levelIcons[metrics.nextLevel.name],
                                                            `Faltam ${formatCurrency(metrics.remainingForNextLevel)} para atingir o nível ${metrics.nextLevel.name} (${formatCurrency(metrics.nextLevel.value)})`
                                                            )
                                                        ) : (
                                                                renderMetric(
                                                                "Nível máximo atingido!",
                                                                " ",
                                                                <Gem className="h-4 w-4 text-sky-400" />,
                                                                "Todos os níveis foram atingidos!"
                                                            )
                                                        )}
                                                        {renderMetric(
                                                            "Falta para Diamante",
                                                            formatCurrency(Math.max(0, metrics.totalLevelTarget - (goal.realizado ?? 0))),
                                                            <BarChart2 className="h-4 w-4" />,
                                                            "Valor restante para atingir a meta Diamante."
                                                        )}
                                                        </>
                                                    ) : goal.hasLevels ? (
                                                        metrics.nextLevel ? (
                                                            renderMetric(
                                                            `Próx. Nível (${metrics.nextLevel.name})`,
                                                            formatFunction(metrics.remainingForNextLevel),
                                                            <BarChart2 className="h-4 w-4" />,
                                                            `Faltam ${formatFunction(metrics.remainingForNextLevel)} para atingir o nível ${metrics.nextLevel.name} (${formatFunction(metrics.nextLevel.value)})`
                                                            )
                                                        ) : (
                                                                renderMetric(
                                                                "Nível máximo atingido!",
                                                                " ",
                                                                <Gem className="h-4 w-4 text-sky-400" />,
                                                                "Todos os níveis foram atingidos!"
                                                            )
                                                        )
                                                        ) : (
                                                        renderMetric(
                                                            "Falta para a Meta",
                                                            isFreight ? formatCurrency(metrics.remainingForTotal) : formatFunction(metrics.remainingForTotal),
                                                            <BarChart2 className="h-4 w-4" />,
                                                            `Falta para atingir a meta total de ${isFreight ? formatCurrency(goal.targetValue) : formatFunction(goal.targetValue)}`
                                                        )
                                                        )}
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                                )
                                            })}
                                        </AccordionContent>
                                    </AccordionItem>
                                );
                            })}
                            </Accordion>
                            
                            <Accordion type="single" collapsible className="w-full pt-4">
                                <AccordionItem value="item-1">
                                    <AccordionTrigger>
                                        <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold">Resumo Total do Grupo</h3>
                                    </AccordionTrigger>
                                    <AccordionContent className="space-y-4 pt-4">
                                        {goalTypeTotals.map(total => (
                                            <Card key={total.goalType.id} className="bg-muted/30">
                                                <CardHeader>
                                                    <CardTitle className="text-lg">Total da Meta: {total.goalType.name}</CardTitle>
                                                </CardHeader>
                                                <CardContent>
                                                    <div className="mb-2">
                                                        <div className="mb-1 flex justify-end text-sm font-medium">
                                                            <div className="text-muted-foreground font-mono whitespace-nowrap ml-auto">
                                                                <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{formatCurrency(total.totalRealizado)}</span> / {formatCurrency(total.totalMeta)}
                                                            </div>
                                                        </div>
                                                        <Progress value={total.totalAchievement} />
                                                    </div>
                                                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 pt-2">
                                                        {renderMetric(
                                                            "Atingimento Total", 
                                                            formatPercentage(total.totalAchievement), 
                                                            <Award className="h-4 w-4" />
                                                        )}
                                                        {renderMetric(
                                                            "Projeção Total",
                                                            formatCurrency(total.totalProjection),
                                                            total.totalProjection >= total.totalMeta ? <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500"/> : <TrendingDown className="h-4 w-4 text-red-500" />,
                                                            "Estimativa de resultado total no final do grupo de períodos com base no desempenho atual."
                                                        )}
                                                    </div>
                                                </CardContent>
                                            </Card>
                                        ))}
                                    </AccordionContent>
                                </AccordionItem>
                            </Accordion>
                        </AccordionContent>
                        </Card>
                    </AccordionItem>
                )
            })}
          </Accordion>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```
